title: pvSliceAlongPolyLine
body:
## pvSliceAlongPolyLine

Cuts a dataset with the curtain surface swept by moving a polyline parallel to the z-axis, like a vertical cross-section along a ship track, river or flight path. Connect the dataset to Dataset and the path (polydata containing a polyline) to PolyLine; the result is polygonal data with interpolated attributes. Only the polyline's x-y path matters. For a single straight cut use pvSlice or slice.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The sweep direction is always the z-axis; rotate the data first (transform) if the vertical direction of your model is another axis.
- If parts of the curtain are missing, increase Tolerance.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `SliceAlongPolyLine`. Identity: `filters/SliceAlongPolyLine`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Dataset` | Required data input for the native Dataset port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: Set the vtkDataObject to slice. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |
| `PolyLine` | Required data input for the native PolyLine port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: Set the polyline to slice along. Accepted data: polygonal data (surfaces, lines or vertices) (vtkPolyData). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPolyData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Tolerance` | The threshold used internally to determine correspondence between the polyline and the output slice. If the output has sections missing, increasing this value may help. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvSliceAlongPolyLine",
  "inputs": {
    "Dataset": "UPSTREAM_Dataset",
    "PolyLine": "UPSTREAM_PolyLine"
  }
}
```
